// defect: A `globalTimeout` that ran out while the second suite ran, as `--global-timeout=2500` left it (measured) and `--global-timeout=12250` prints it: the repetition in flight keeps one result, `skipped`, the one after it has none, and `errors` hold two sentences — the stop's, and one more for the teardown that ran out of the same time. A teardown that runs out of time is no early stop (`a-timeout-in-the-teardown.json`), so a rule that reads only the last error, or asks about other errors before it asks about stops, calls this run an error outside a test. Playwright prints the timeout as its milliseconds over a thousand, two digits either side of the point here, which a sentence copied from one measurement does not expect.
